name: Backside Glance ISO RPO
formation: Gun 3x1 Trips Right, Solo X Left

summary.motive: Put the backside Will linebacker in an impossible run-pass conflict: if he steps up to stop the interior Duo run, punish him immediately with a rapid Glance route to the isolated X receiver.
summary.whyItWorks: The threat of Philadelphia’s interior double teams forces the Will LB to commit downhill into the B-gap; the isolated X receiver wins instantly on an inside slant with zero safety help.
summary.failureMode: Will linebacker freezing in the passing lane to bat the ball down or boundary cornerback jumping the slant inside with aggressive trap technique.

beats.title: 1. The Duo Run Action & Conflict Read
beats.text: From identical 3x1 Trips Right formation, the offensive line drives forward on an interior run block. QB rides the mesh with the RB while staring down the backside Will linebacker.

beats.title: 2. The Will LB Sucked Into the Box
beats.text: Stung by inside Duo on previous downs, the Will linebacker triggers downhill into the B-gap to stop the running back, completely vacating the intermediate slant window behind him.

beats.title: 3. The Clean Pull & Glance Laser
beats.text: QB snatches the ball out of the mesh, flips his hips, and fires a 12-yard dart to the isolated X receiver snapping inside on a physical 5-step Glance route.

beats.title: 4. Physical Body Shield & YAC
beats.text: X boxes out the boundary cornerback with his frame, secures the catch in stride between the numbers and hash, and rumbles forward for a 16-yard first down.

relations.tell: Quarterback keeping eyes locked on the backside linebacker during the mesh rather than carrying out a naked keeper.
